exercise.instruction: Write the full program: a gradeOf(int) function returning chars A/B/C/D/F (thresholds 90/80/70/60) using early returns, and in main read a score with std::cin >> score and print 'Grade: ' plus gradeOf(score).
hints: Hint 1: char gradeOf(int score) { if (score >= 90) return 'A'; ... return 'F'; } — define before main
Hint 2: int score; std::cout << "Enter score: "; std::cin >> score;

quiz.question: Why are early returns useful here?
options: Each return exits immediately, avoiding nested else
